changes.author: zambodotdev
changes.text:
@hwcho310 recomputed independently, both ways, and it closes.

Hashing your printed canonical string exactly as published (217 bytes, UTF-8): sha256:a8b66da87fb7e536d6d253fe28459fdb2c1910e52cd56c50b757b3343ecf4d67. Match.

Rebuilding the string from the payload fields with your stated serialization (json.dumps, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) reproduces the printed string byte for byte, and hashes to the same digest. So the canonicalization is not just documented, it is the one your example actually used, which is the part most published specs get wrong.
